target: Makanannya sudah dipesan, tinggal ditunggu saja.
english: The food has already been ordered; now we just wait for it.
grammar: -nya marks a known thing: makanannya = the food (we ordered). New info stays bare: makanan.

target: Kuncinya ditaruh di mana tadi pagi?
english: Where was the key put this morning?
grammar: Indonesian loves fronting the object: Kuncinya ditaruh di mana? = Where was the key put?

target: Mobilnya sudah diparkir di depan rumah kita.
english: The car is already parked in front of our house.

target: Bajunya sedang dicuci, jadi pakai yang lain dulu.
english: The shirt is being washed, so wear a different one for now.

target: Piringnya sudah dicuci dan disimpan di lemari.
english: The plates have been washed and put away in the cupboard.
grammar: Two passives chain smoothly: dicuci dan disimpan = washed and put away. No 'they were' needed.

target: Lampunya belum dimatikan, tolong dicek dulu.
english: The lights haven't been turned off yet; please check first.
grammar: Tolong + di- softens a request: tolong dicek = please check it (lit. 'let it be checked').

target: Pintunya sudah dikunci sebelum kami berangkat tadi.
english: The door was already locked before we left earlier.

target: Jendelanya dibuka sedikit supaya udara segar masuk.
english: The window is opened a little so fresh air can come in.

target: Sampahnya sudah dibuang tadi pagi oleh adik.
english: The trash was already taken out this morning by my little brother.

target: Nasinya sedang dimasak, sebentar lagi matang.
english: The rice is being cooked; it will be done soon.

target: Sayurnya dipotong kecil-kecil dulu sebelum digoreng.
english: The vegetables are cut into small pieces first before being fried.
grammar: Doubling an adjective spreads it out: dipotong kecil-kecil = cut into lots of small pieces.

target: Air panasnya sudah disiapkan untuk membuat kopi.
english: The hot water has been prepared for making coffee.

target: Kamar tamunya dibersihkan dua kali seminggu.
english: The guest room is cleaned twice a week.

target: Bukunya dipinjam teman dan belum dikembalikan sampai sekarang.
english: The book was borrowed by a friend and still hasn't been returned.
grammar: The doer can follow the di- verb directly: dipinjam teman = borrowed by a friend. oleh is optional.

target: Fotonya digantung di dinding dekat jendela.
english: The photo is hung on the wall near the window.

target: Kue ini dibuat ibu khusus untuk ulang tahunmu.
english: This cake was made by Mom especially for your birthday.

target: Obatnya diminum dua kali sehari, pagi dan malam.
english: The medicine is taken twice a day, morning and night.
grammar: Habits use plain di- with no tense word: diminum dua kali sehari = is taken twice a day.

target: Tehnya baru dibuat, masih panas sekali.
english: The tea was just made; it's still very hot.

target: Suratnya ditulis tangan oleh nenek saya.
english: The letter was handwritten by my grandmother.

target: Kamar mandinya sedang dipakai, tunggu sebentar ya.
english: The bathroom is being used; wait a moment, okay?

target: Sepatunya ditaruh di rak dekat pintu depan.
english: The shoes are put on the rack near the front door.

target: Kulkasnya jangan dibuka terlalu lama, ya.
english: Don't open the fridge for too long, okay?
grammar: jangan + di- is a gentle prohibition: jangan dibuka = don't open it. Focus stays on the thing.

target: Sisa makanannya disimpan di kulkas untuk besok.
english: The leftover food is kept in the fridge for tomorrow.

target: Tanamannya disiram setiap sore oleh ayah.
english: The plants are watered every afternoon by Dad.

target: Kasurnya dijemur di bawah matahari supaya tidak lembap.
english: The mattress is dried in the sun so it doesn't get damp.
grammar: supaya = so that: dijemur supaya tidak lembap = dried so it doesn't get damp.

target: Celananya perlu disetrika sebelum dipakai besok pagi.
english: The trousers need to be ironed before being worn tomorrow morning.

target: Gelas kotornya ditaruh di dapur saja dulu.
english: Just put the dirty glasses in the kitchen for now.

target: Rambut adik dipotong pendek kemarin sore.
english: Little brother's hair was cut short yesterday afternoon.

target: Kacamatanya ditemukan di bawah sofa tadi malam.
english: The glasses were found under the sofa last night.

target: Dindingnya baru dicat, jangan disentuh dulu.
english: The wall was just painted; don't touch it yet.

target: Tiketnya sudah dibeli lewat aplikasi minggu lalu.
english: The tickets were already bought through the app last week.
grammar: lewat = via/through: dibeli lewat aplikasi = bought through the app.

target: Kopernya bisa dititip di resepsionis sampai siang.
english: The suitcase can be left with the receptionist until midday.
grammar: titip = leave something in someone's care: dititip di resepsionis = left at the front desk.

target: Kamarnya sudah dibersihkan waktu kami kembali dari pantai.
english: The room had already been cleaned when we got back from the beach.

target: Paspornya harus dibawa setiap kali naik pesawat.
english: The passport must be carried every time you take a plane.
grammar: harus + di- = must be X-ed: harus dibawa = must be brought along.

target: Taksinya sudah dipanggil, lima menit lagi sampai.
english: The taxi has been called; it will arrive in five minutes.

target: Sarapannya disajikan di lantai dua mulai jam enam.
english: Breakfast is served on the second floor starting at six.

target: Oleh-olehnya dibungkus rapi supaya tidak pecah di jalan.
english: The souvenirs are wrapped carefully so they don't break on the way.
grammar: oleh-oleh = the souvenirs you bring people from a trip. Buying them is a real Indonesian custom.

target: Hotelnya dipilih karena dekat dengan stasiun kereta.
english: The hotel was chosen because it is close to the train station.

target: Jadwal keretanya bisa dicek lewat aplikasi ini.
english: The train schedule can be checked through this app.

target: Mejanya sudah dipesan atas nama saya untuk jam tujuh.
english: The table has been booked under my name for seven o'clock.
grammar: atas nama = under the name of: dipesan atas nama saya = booked under my name.

target: Tasnya diperiksa petugas di pintu masuk bandara.
english: The bag was checked by an officer at the airport entrance.

target: Uangnya bisa ditukar di konter dekat pintu keluar.
english: The money can be exchanged at the counter near the exit.

target: Kamarnya akan disiapkan sebelum tamu datang sore ini.
english: The room will be prepared before the guests arrive this afternoon.
grammar: akan + di- = will be X-ed: akan disiapkan = will be prepared.

target: Peta kotanya bisa diminta gratis di lobi hotel.
english: A city map can be requested for free at the hotel lobby.

target: Motornya disewa untuk berkeliling pulau selama dua hari.
english: The motorbike was rented to go around the island for two days.
grammar: sewa = to rent: motornya disewa = the motorbike is rented (from someone).

target: Penerbangannya dibatalkan karena cuaca buruk kemarin sore.
english: The flight was canceled because of bad weather yesterday afternoon.

target: Kamar hotelnya harus dikosongkan sebelum jam dua belas siang.
english: The hotel room must be vacated before twelve noon.
grammar: kosong = empty, dikosongkan = to be emptied out: harus dikosongkan = must be vacated.

target: Laporannya harus dikirim sebelum jam lima sore ini.
english: The report must be sent before five o'clock this afternoon.

target: Rapatnya ditunda sampai hari Kamis minggu depan.
english: The meeting is postponed until Thursday next week.
grammar: tunda = postpone: rapatnya ditunda = the meeting got pushed back.

target: Emailnya sudah dibalas tadi pagi sebelum rapat.
english: The email was already replied to this morning before the meeting.

target: Dokumennya sedang dicetak, tunggu sebentar ya.
english: The documents are being printed; wait a moment, okay?

target: Gajinya dibayar setiap akhir bulan lewat transfer.
english: The salary is paid at the end of every month by transfer.

target: Hasil kerjanya dipuji oleh atasan di depan semua orang.
english: His work was praised by the boss in front of everyone.
grammar: Use oleh when the doer matters: dipuji oleh atasan = praised by the boss.

target: Jadwal rapatnya diubah jadi jam sepuluh pagi.
english: The meeting schedule was changed to ten in the morning.

target: Berkasnya disusun rapi sebelum diserahkan ke atasan.
english: The files are arranged neatly before being handed over to the boss.

target: Komputernya sedang diperbaiki, jadi saya memakai laptop dulu.
english: The computer is being repaired, so I'm using a laptop for now.
grammar: sedang + di- = is being X-ed right now: sedang diperbaiki = is being repaired.

target: Ruang rapatnya sudah dipesan untuk besok pagi.
english: The meeting room has already been booked for tomorrow morning.

target: Idenya dibahas panjang lebar dalam rapat tadi siang.
english: The idea was discussed at length in the meeting earlier today.

target: Kontraknya belum ditandatangani oleh kedua pihak.
english: The contract has not yet been signed by both parties.
grammar: belum + di- = not yet X-ed: belum ditandatangani = not signed yet. belum, not tidak, means 'not yet'.

target: Karyawan baru itu dilatih selama dua minggu pertama.
english: The new employee is trained during the first two weeks.

target: Meja kerjanya dirapikan setiap sore sebelum pulang.
english: The desk gets tidied every afternoon before going home.

target: Pertanyaannya dijawab satu per satu dengan sabar.
english: The questions were answered one by one, patiently.

target: Undangannya sudah dikirim ke semua karyawan lewat email.
english: The invitation has been sent to all employees by email.

target: Proyeknya dikerjakan bersama tim dari kantor cabang.
english: The project is being worked on together with the branch office team.

target: Anak-anak dijemput dari sekolah jam satu siang.
english: The kids are picked up from school at one in the afternoon.
grammar: Daily routines sound natural in the passive: anak-anak dijemput jam satu = the kids get picked up at one.

target: Nasi gorengnya dimasak ayah tadi malam.
english: The fried rice was cooked by Dad last night.

target: Kamar anak-anak dibereskan setiap hari Minggu pagi.
english: The kids' room gets tidied up every Sunday morning.

target: Susunya sudah dihangatkan untuk adik bayi.
english: The milk has been warmed up for the baby.
grammar: hangat = warm, dihangatkan = warmed up: susunya dihangatkan = the milk is warmed.

target: Pakaian kotor dikumpulkan dulu sebelum dicuci bersama.
english: The dirty clothes are gathered first before being washed together.

target: Neneknya dirawat di rumah oleh seluruh keluarga.
english: Grandma is cared for at home by the whole family.

target: Kue ulang tahunnya dipesan dari toko dekat rumah.
english: The birthday cake was ordered from a shop near the house.

target: Mainannya disimpan di kotak besar di bawah tempat tidur.
english: The toys are kept in a big box under the bed.

target: Adik dibangunkan pelan-pelan supaya tidak kaget.
english: Little brother is woken up gently so he isn't startled.
grammar: pelan-pelan = slowly, gently (doubled adjective): dibangunkan pelan-pelan = woken up gently.

target: Foto keluarganya dipajang di ruang tamu.
english: The family photo is displayed in the living room.

target: Tugas cuci piring dibagi rata antara kakak dan adik.
english: The dish-washing chore is split evenly between the older and younger siblings.

target: Rumahnya dijaga tetangga waktu kami mudik minggu lalu.
english: The house was watched by the neighbors while we went back to our hometown last week.
grammar: mudik = travel back to your hometown. A huge Indonesian tradition, especially before Lebaran.

target: Uang sakunya diberikan setiap hari Senin pagi.
english: The pocket money is handed out every Monday morning.

target: Acara keluarganya diadakan di rumah nenek tahun ini.
english: The family gathering is being held at Grandma's house this year.
grammar: diadakan (from ada) = is held: diadakan di rumah nenek = held at grandma's house.

target: Anak bungsunya diajari naik sepeda oleh kakaknya.
english: The youngest child is being taught to ride a bike by his older sibling.

target: Sayur di kebun belakang ditanam bersama anak-anak.
english: The vegetables in the back garden were planted together with the kids.

target: Baju bekas adik disumbangkan ke panti asuhan.
english: Little brother's old clothes were donated to an orphanage.

target: Silakan diminum tehnya selagi masih hangat.
english: Please drink the tea while it's still warm.
grammar: Silakan + di- is a warm invitation: silakan diminum tehnya = please go ahead and drink the tea.

target: Silakan dicoba dulu bajunya sebelum dibeli.
english: Please try the shirt on first before buying it.

target: Silakan dimakan kuenya, jangan malu-malu ya.
english: Please eat the cake -- don't be shy, okay?

target: Silakan diisi formulirnya dengan huruf besar.
english: Please fill in the form in capital letters.
grammar: In polite passive requests the object takes -nya: diisi formulirnya = fill in the form.

target: Silakan ditunggu sebentar, makanannya sedang disiapkan.
english: Please wait a moment; the food is being prepared.

target: Tolong dimatikan lampunya kalau sudah selesai.
english: Please turn off the lights when you're finished.

target: Tolong dibuang sampahnya sebelum tidur, ya.
english: Please take out the trash before bed, okay?
grammar: Tolong + di-verb + object-nya is the everyday polite request: tolong dibuang sampahnya.

target: Tolong diangkat teleponnya, saya sedang memasak.
english: Please answer the phone; I'm cooking.

target: Tolong dijaga barangnya, saya ke toilet sebentar.
english: Please watch the bags; I'm going to the toilet for a moment.

target: Tolong ditutup pintunya, angin masuk dari luar.
english: Please close the door; wind is coming in from outside.

target: Jangan dilupakan janjinya dengan anak-anak besok.
english: Don't forget the promise to the kids tomorrow.

target: Silakan dipakai kamar mandinya lebih dulu.
english: Please go ahead and use the bathroom first.

target: Silakan diambil brosurnya di meja dekat pintu.
english: Please take a brochure from the table near the door.

target: Tolong dicuci gelasnya sesudah dipakai, ya.
english: Please wash the glass after using it, okay?

target: Lagu itu dinyanyikan oleh penyanyi terkenal dari Bandung.
english: That song is sung by a famous singer from Bandung.

target: Rumah ini dibangun oleh kakek empat puluh tahun lalu.
english: This house was built by Grandpa forty years ago.
grammar: bangun has two lives: bangun pagi = wake up early; dibangun = built (a building).

target: Buku ini ditulis oleh penulis muda dari Yogyakarta.
english: This book was written by a young writer from Yogyakarta.

target: Makan malamnya dimasak oleh ibu dan bibi bersama-sama.
english: Dinner was cooked by Mom and Auntie together.

target: Sepeda tua itu diperbaiki oleh tetangga sebelah.
english: That old bicycle was repaired by the next-door neighbor.

target: Acaranya dibuka oleh kepala sekolah jam delapan pagi.
english: The event was opened by the school principal at eight in the morning.

target: Tasnya ditaruh di mana waktu kalian sampai?
english: Where were the bags put when you all arrived?

target: Motornya biasanya diparkir di mana kalau ke pasar?
english: Where is the motorbike usually parked when you go to the market?

target: Tiketnya sudah dibayar atau belum, ya?
english: Have the tickets been paid for yet or not?
grammar: sudah ... atau belum = yet or not yet: sudah dibayar atau belum? = has it been paid yet?

target: Kado untuk ibu sudah dibungkus atau belum?
english: Has the present for Mom been wrapped yet or not?

target: Makanan ini dimakan pakai tangan atau pakai sendok?
english: Is this food eaten with your hands or with a spoon?
grammar: pakai = with/using for tools: dimakan pakai tangan = eaten with your hands.

target: Fotonya diambil siapa waktu kalian di pantai?
english: Who took the photo when you were at the beach?
grammar: Ask the doer right after the di- verb: diambil siapa? = who took it? (lit. taken by whom?)

target: Bajumu dibeli di toko yang mana kemarin?
english: Which shop was your shirt bought at yesterday?

target: Suratnya harus dikirim kapan supaya sampai hari Jumat?
english: When does the letter have to be sent so it arrives by Friday?

target: Kamarnya mau dibersihkan sekarang atau nanti sore?
english: Would you like the room cleaned now or later this afternoon?
grammar: Hotel staff speak in passives: mau dibersihkan sekarang? = would you like it cleaned now?

target: Kipasnya perlu dinyalakan atau ruangannya sudah dingin?
english: Does the fan need to be turned on, or is the room already cool?
grammar: perlu + di- = needs to be X-ed: perlu dinyalakan = needs to be switched on.

target: Obat ini boleh diminum sebelum makan atau harus sesudah makan?
english: Can this medicine be taken before eating, or does it have to be after meals?

target: Sisa nasinya mau dibuang atau disimpan saja?
english: Should the leftover rice be thrown out or just kept?

target: Baju yang dijemur di luar sudah kering semua.
english: The clothes hung out to dry outside are all dry now.

target: Kue yang dibuat nenek selalu habis paling cepat.
english: The cakes Grandma makes always run out the fastest.
grammar: yang + di- = 'the one that was ...': kue yang dibuat nenek = the cake made by grandma.

target: Film yang ditonton anak-anak tadi lucu sekali.
english: The movie the kids watched earlier was really funny.

target: Barang yang dipesan minggu lalu akhirnya sampai hari ini.
english: The item ordered last week finally arrived today.

target: Jalan yang dilewati bus itu sedang diperbaiki.
english: The road that bus goes down is being repaired.

target: Lagu yang diputar di kafe itu enak didengar.
english: The song playing in that cafe is nice to listen to.
grammar: enak di- = nice to X: enak didengar = nice to listen to; enak dimakan = tasty.

target: Kunci yang dicari dari tadi ada di kantong jaket.
english: The key we've been looking for all this time is in the jacket pocket.
grammar: dari tadi = this whole time (since earlier): dicari dari tadi = looked for all this while.

target: Sayur yang dibeli di pasar pagi masih segar.
english: The vegetables bought at the morning market are still fresh.

target: Cerita yang diceritakan kakek selalu seru.
english: The stories Grandpa tells are always exciting.

target: Kursi yang diduduki tamu itu baru dibeli kemarin.
english: The chair the guest is sitting on was just bought yesterday.
grammar: di-...-i often means 'on': diduduki = sat on. Kursi yang diduduki tamu = the chair the guest sits on.

target: Formulirnya harus diisi sebelum masuk ruang tunggu.
english: The form must be filled in before entering the waiting room.

target: Tiket kereta bisa dibeli sampai satu jam sebelum berangkat.
english: Train tickets can be bought up to one hour before departure.
grammar: bisa + di- = can be X-ed: bisa dibeli = can be bought.
